sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated urgency because being late on the very first day is exactly the kind of bad start she wanted to avoid.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Why today of all days? My alarm worked! I know it did!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and incredulous, half-panicking as she tries to defend herself against the unfairness of being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s suddenly panicked and flustered, with a sharp spike of anxiety as she realizes her missing pass could make her already-late morning even worse.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on, don't do this to me!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is panicking and desperately trying to keep herself together, with rising frustration and a pleading, flustered urgency as she searches for her missing pass.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously... I stopped to read that creepy note, and now my pass is gone?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and indignant, with a rising panic turning into frustrated self-blame as she realizes her delay may have cost her her transit pass.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: I'm late, I'm cardless, and I'm trying very hard not to become a tragedy in a school uniform.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and near-panicked, but still trying to joke her way through the embarrassment and keep herself from fully spiraling.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of disbelief and wary hope, as if the bizarre note and the attendant’s clue have suddenly turned her panic into stunned suspicion that this might actually be real.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is breathless, panicked, and embarrassed, but also energized by the urgency and determined to push through with a flustered, apologetic burst of confidence.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sudden, breathless relief and grateful excitement, with a burst of hopeful energy after the panic of thinking her first day was ruined.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and instantly wary, with her earlier panic shifting into tense suspicion as she tries to understand how a stranger knows so much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. That's not a normal sentence.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and wary, but trying to mask it with dry humor while her mind races to figure out who this person is and why they know so much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: confused

sprite_sequence.text: Did my friends put you up to this? Because this prank is way too elaborate for eight in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled but trying to regain control with joking suspicion, masking a spike of unease and confusion with her usual outspoken, energetic bravado.
sprite_sequence.label: confused

sprite_sequence.text: That made it worse. You know that, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of alarm, irritation, and wary confusion, trying to push back against the stranger’s unsettling cryptic behavior while still being visibly rattled.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into alarmed disbelief, trying to reject the eerie situation outright while masking her fear with blunt, emphatic denial.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: People do not just vanish before homeroom!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into incredulous, rising panic, trying to force the situation back into something normal while her bravado masks how unnerved she feels.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Aah— school! Mystery later, attendance first!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, upbeat determination to outrun her fear, using humor and urgency to stay in control despite being rattled by the eerie encounter.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Seat by the window, huh... If that's true, who were you?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is rattled but curious, trying to turn her fear into a brisk, investigative confidence as she wonders whether the stranger is someone from school.
sprite_sequence.label: confused
